title: Rain

source.name: Simple English Wikipedia — Rain
source.note: Chuyển thể sang mức A1 (câu ngắn, từ đơn giản); thông tin theo bài gốc.

paras: Rain is water that falls from clouds in the sky. Hail, sleet and snow also fall from clouds. All of these are called precipitation. People measure rain with a rain gauge.
Rain is part of the water cycle. Some places have a lot of rain. These places make rainforests. Some places have very little rain. These places make deserts.

questions.explain: Đoạn 1: “Rain is water that falls from clouds in the sky.”

questions.q: What do people use to measure rain?
questions.explain: Đoạn 1: “People measure rain with a rain gauge.”

questions.q: What do places with a lot of rain make?
questions.explain: Đoạn 2: “Some places have a lot of rain. These places make rainforests.”

questions.q: What is rain a part of?
questions.explain: Đoạn 2: “Rain is part of the water cycle.”
Đoạn 1: “Hail, sleet and snow also fall from clouds.”

questions.q: Deserts have a lot of rain.
questions.explain: Đoạn 2: “Some places have very little rain. These places make deserts.”
